run_single_point_orca_calculation: run a single-point ORCA energy calculation on an Atoms object with a specified functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run an ORCA geometry optimization on an Atoms object using the ase_relaxation function with custom optimizer parameters
run_orca_calculation_with_nbo: run a single-point ORCA calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled via the nbo flag
run_orca_calculation_metal_organics: run a single-point ORCA calculation for metal-organic systems with symmetry breaking using the vertical MetalOrganics setting
run_orca_relaxation_with_restart: run an ORCA geometry optimization with a custom step counter start index for restarting interrupted optimizations
